title: Books and reading
description: Name the parts of a book, and say what you read.
grammar: gender and articles, and the words for reading
grammarNote: The words for books are nouns, and most of them are feminine.

explanation.summary: Books are made of parts, and each part has a name. This unit gives you the nouns and the verbs that go with them.

sections.heading: The nouns
sections.body: El periódico, el título, el autor and el cuento are masculine. La lectura, la revista, la página, la letra, la frase y la idea are feminine. La lectura is the reading, and it is also the activity: la lectura es buena.

sections.heading: What is in the book
sections.body: Estar says where a thing is, and the parts of a book are things: el título está en la portada, la frase está en la página. Leer is to read, and it is a regular -ar verb: leo, lees, lee.

examples.es: leo el periódico por la mañana
examples.en: I read the newspaper in the morning

examples.es: la página está en el libro
examples.en: the page is in the book

examples.es: el cuento es de un autor español
examples.en: the story is by a Spanish author

items.note: Masculine: el periódico. The accent marks the stress.
Feminine: la página. The accent marks the stress.
Masculine: el título. The accent marks the stress.
Masculine: el autor. The feminine es la autora.
Feminine: la letra. It means the letter of the alphabet and the lyrics of a song.
